floor_history.headline: Sibling func_800483DC base-routing idiom drops floor 11->10 (clean pure C); c/d sign-extend fix killed (cascades to 22 via v1-walker scratch collision).

frontier.hypothesis: Make the walker register DEAD-and-reusable at the d-load so GCC reuses it as the d sign-extend scratch, mirroring target's lhu v0,0(v1); lhu v1,2(v1).
frontier.mechanism: The walker's last live use must be the d-load itself; nothing after (incl. entry+=base) may reference it. Then GCC can allocate the d sign-extend scratch onto the just-freed walker reg instead of pushing the walker out.
frontier.next_probe: From candidate.c (floor 10), reorder so d is the final walker read and entry+=base precedes the c/d loads; try loading d before c, or read c/d off a fixed base with no post-increment past c so the pointer is dead at d; sandbox each.

frontier.hypothesis: Fix the move t0,v1 prologue scheduling (target emits the base copy before the sw ra/sw s0 stores).
frontier.mechanism: Emitting base=arg0 earlier in source may schedule the copy into the prologue region ahead of the register saves.
frontier.next_probe: Assign base=arg0 as the very first statement (before the index computation); sandbox.

frontier.hypothesis: Permuter campaign from the floor-10 base can find the combined register/scheduling lever.
frontier.mechanism: Clean single-function target at offset 0; the base score is now real weighted diff (10), so randomization + directed PERM macros have gradient.
frontier.next_probe: permuter_campaign from candidate.c, --stop-on-zero, fresh-seed windows via wait; harvest --stop in-turn.
